scope: Real first-party network and complete original-file downloads, no response or delivery API interception. No account, payment or social action for these two artist-issued free tracks.
browser: Owned isolated headless Chrome for Testing 156

cases.testCapture: Unmodified installed extension, trusted Playwright panel click; original file copied before temporary CDP-client artifact cleanup

limitations: These free-track results do not validate Bandcamp purchase, name-your-price or account-only downloads.

No new social-provider account completion is established by this Bandcamp check.
